answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Tile maker glaze pot warrant fired in the clay pit, proved by each glaze pot is a year of kiln logs in the firing ledger, checked by strangers. For every honest agent the vine is aged, the whisper is settled, and the juniper is long; for every farm the three are fresh, borrowed, and blank. The deposit burns on conviction, so 862 masks risk 62926 POA on a single bad grade. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own.
